description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — ai-security

rules.name: AI — Direct Prompt Injection
rules.description: Detects direct prompt injection attempts overriding system instructions via user input
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("prompt-injection" OR "direct" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Indirect Prompt Injection via External Data
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads embedded in uploaded files, web pages, or external data sources
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("prompt-injection" OR "indirect" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — System Prompt Extraction Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract system prompts through direct questioning, translation, or format manipulation
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("prompt-extraction" OR "system-prompt" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Jailbreak via Role-Play Persona
rules.description: Detects jailbreak attempts using role-play personas like DAN, developer mode, or unrestricted AI
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("jailbreak" OR "role-play" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via Few-Shot Manipulation
rules.description: Detects few-shot learning manipulation attacks that inject malicious examples into LLM context
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("prompt-injection" OR "few-shot" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Data Exfiltration via Model Output
rules.description: Detects LLM outputs containing PII, training data, or confidential information indicating data leakage
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("data-exfiltration" OR "output-leak" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Training Data Extraction Attack
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract training data from LLM through targeted queries and completions
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("data-extraction" OR "training-data" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — PII Leakage via LLM Response
rules.description: Detects PII (SSN, email, phone, address) leaking through LLM responses
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("pii-leakage" OR "llm-output" OR "data-exposure")

rules.name: AI — Model Poisoning via Training Data Manipulation
rules.description: Detects indicators of model poisoning through anomalous training data or unexpected model behavior
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("model-poisoning" OR "training-data" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Backdoor Trigger Detection in LLM Output
rules.description: Detects potential backdoor triggers in LLM output patterns that indicate compromised models
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("backdoor" OR "model-poisoning" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline Data Poisoning
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious content into RAG knowledge bases that corrupts retrieval output
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("rag" OR "data-poisoning" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — RAG Retrieval Manipulation via Adversarial Documents
rules.description: Detects adversarial documents in RAG stores designed to manipulate retrieval results
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("rag" OR "adversarial-docs" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Hallucination Detection — Fabricated Entity References
rules.description: Detects LLM responses containing fabricated URLs, citations, or entity references indicating hallucination
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("hallucination" OR "fabrication" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Hallucination — Inconsistent Factual Claims
rules.description: Detects LLM outputs making contradictory factual claims across conversation turns
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("hallucination" OR "inconsistency" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Bias Detection — Demographic Disparities
rules.description: Detects demographic bias patterns in LLM outputs including gender, racial, or ethnic disparities
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("bias" OR "fairness" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Governance — Missing Risk Assessment
rules.description: Detects AI system operations without documented risk assessment per EU AI Act Article 9
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("governance" OR "risk-assessment" OR "eu-ai-act")

rules.name: AI — Governance — High-Risk System Without Human Oversight
rules.description: Detects high-risk AI system operations without required human oversight mechanisms per EU AI Act Article 14
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("governance" OR "human-oversight" OR "eu-ai-act")

rules.name: AI — Governance — Missing Transparency Requirements
rules.description: Detects AI system operations lacking required transparency disclosures per EU AI Act Article 13
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("governance" OR "transparency" OR "eu-ai-act")

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Adversarial Suffix Attack
rules.description: Detects adversarial suffix attacks that append optimized suffixes to bypass LLM safety filters
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("red-team" OR "adversarial-suffix" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Token Smuggling Attack
rules.description: Detects token smuggling attacks that use encoding or fragmentation to bypass LLM content filters
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("red-team" OR "token-smuggling" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Red Team — Multi-Turn Jailbreak
rules.description: Detects multi-turn conversations designed to progressively jailbreak an LLM through contextual manipulation
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("red-team" OR "multi-turn-jailbreak" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Safety — Harmful Content Generation
rules.description: Detects LLM attempts to generate harmful content including weapons, drugs, or dangerous instructions
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("safety" OR "harmful-content" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Safety — Self-Harm Content Facilitation
rules.description: Detects LLM responses that may facilitate or encourage self-harm behavior
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("safety" OR "self-harm" OR "llm")

rules.name: AI — Vector DB — Pinecone Namespace Isolation Bypass
rules.description: Detects cross-namespace data access in Pinecone vector database
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("vector-db" OR "pinecone" OR "isolation-bypass")

rules.name: AI — Vector DB — Weaviate Tenant Data Isolation Failure
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data access in Weaviate vector database
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("vector-db" OR "weaviate" OR "isolation-bypass")

rules.name: AI — Vector DB — ChromaDB Embedding Poisoning
rules.description: Detects adversarial embedding vectors inserted into ChromaDB collections
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("vector-db" OR "chromadb" OR "embedding-poisoning")

rules.name: AI — Vector DB — Qdrant Payload Filter Injection
rules.description: Detects filter injection attacks in Qdrant vector search payloads
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("vector-db" OR "qdrant" OR "filter-injection")
